overview: This Senate resolution congratulates the Seattle Seahawks for beating the New England Patriots 29 to 13 to win Super Bowl LX on February 8, 2026, in Santa Clara, California. It recounts highlights of the team's season and the game, recognizing players, the coaches, team leadership and the Seahawks' fans, known as the "12s." It directs the Secretary of the Senate to send copies of the resolution to the team's chair, president, general manager and head coach. The Senate approved it on February 12, 2026.
for: Supporters say the resolution is a fitting way to celebrate a championship that brought pride to Seattle and the state of Washington.
against: Critics say the resolution is symbolic and does not change any law or spending.
